headline: Fishermen's Row Flares Anew as Kings Cage Toll Mounts
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition comes at Fishermen's Row, silent at the prior filing, where two base events fall within the past two hours, the latest but half an hour before this edition, and twenty-one mark the day, with losses on both sides accelerating sharply; its nine works stand five Colonial to four Warden. Kings Cage, quiet in base affairs since yesterday evening, shows the sharpest fresh climb in casualties, some forty-two hundred colonial and sixty-four hundred warden across the day and swelling hourly, its eight works seven Colonial to one Warden. The Deadlands remain the costliest field, their losses still rising in the latest hour, though no fresh base events are recorded since our last report; eight works stand Colonial to three Warden. Linn Mercy keeps up its heavy exchange without new base events, while the Weathered Expanse's great torrent of casualties at last cools, and Lykos Isle, Stlican Shelf, Loch Mor and Clahstra subside from their peaks. Palantine Berm, absent from our last report, shows a small fresh flare, nearly all of its day's losses falling within six hours. Sixty-two days in, no victor is declared and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
